label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.calm(); game.step(1); JSON.stringify({ touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), scroll: document.getElementById('title').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 })

label: 1P play overlaps
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true }); game.step(1); return JSON.stringify(window.layoutCheck()); })()

label: 2P play overlaps
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true, players: 2 }); game.step(1); return JSON.stringify(window.layoutCheck()); })()

label: results
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.players.forEach((p) => (p.lives = 1)); game.put(0, 1, -5.5); game.put(1, 1, 5.5); w.seals.push({ id: 904, k: 1, x: -4.9, dir: -1, carry: false, st: 'walk', t: 0, life: 20, vy: 0, y: 2.4, wait: 0, home: 1 }, { id: 905, k: 1, x: 6.1, dir: 1, carry: false, st: 'walk', t: 0, life: 20, vy: 0, y: 2.4, wait: 0, home: 1 }); game.step(4); return JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, scroll: document.getElementById('results').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 }); })()
